adjudication.rationale: In `packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx`, the remove button tooltip is hardcoded as `content="Remove email"` even though the component imports `useLocale` and uses `t("add_another")` elsewhere. This makes the tooltip untranslated for non-English locales, unlike other strings added in the diff which use locale keys.
